headline: Prioritize usability: free-tier ads and restricted track controls generate the most complaints and the highest severity volume.
recommendation: Prioritize usability, which has 19 complaints [T1], a 37.3% share of all complaints [T4], and the highest severity sum at 51 [T2]. Within it, ads lead with 8 complaints [C5] and a severity sum of 21 [C6]. Premium gating of skip, back, and song selection overlaps with billing and should be scoped together with usability. Cancellation language is expressed intent only, with 3 usability records [T3].

actions.title: Reduce ad frequency and loudness for free-tier listeners
actions.rationale: Ads are the largest usability issue by complaints [C5] and severity sum [C6], with reviews describing ads replacing songs and interrupting playback.

actions.title: Restore skip, previous-track, and chosen-song controls for free users
actions.rationale: This issue carries a mean severity of 3.000000 [C15] and a severity sum of 15 [C14], showing users feel locked out of basic playback control.

actions.title: Review the home screen redesign and auto-playing audio elements
actions.rationale: Redesign complaints total 4 [C17] with a severity sum of 9 [C18], and one review ties the issue to cancellation intent.

alternatives.why_not_first: Premium gating shows 6 complaints [T13] at a mean severity of 3.000000 [C11]; much of it overlaps with the usability track-control issue, so it is addressed in the same scope.
Playback has 7 complaints [T9] and a severity sum of 22 [T10], but it splits into crash [C25] and other [C29] issues with no single dominant cluster.
Login failures total 2 complaints [T21] with a mean severity of 4.000000 [C23]; volume is small, so monitor rather than lead with it.
Catalog has 4 complaints [T17] and downloads has 1 [T25], both below the usability and billing volumes.

limitations: Reviews are self-selected public feedback and are not a representative user sample.
The data contains no revenue, plan tier, or confirmed churn; cancellation language reflects expressed intent only.
Coverage is 100 rows [X1] with 0 quarantined [X3], of which 51 are complaint or cancellation records [X5].
Only 17 records were verified [X9] and 15 are flagged needs_review [X8], so classification confidence is moderate.
Verifier topic and intent agreement were both 1.0 [X10][X11] on a small sample, with severity mean absolute error of 0.0588 [X12].
The first and last months of the window are partial, which may distort trends.
